body:
Devil is a very good movie for an audience. The acting, story and screenplay all hold the audience. After a long day, Nam Boss will make you laugh, dance, cry, be happy, and stay in your mind 🙏✨ The story is one line, but the director has played a game in the screenplay. He gives the audience a job to do, making your guesses about what will happen next lie and giving a closer that no one knows.

Sudhakar's camera is amazing, Ajaneesh has given good songs and background music. (Krishna song is super) and Achyut Avru and Manjekar, Sarmila Mandre, Rachana Rai, Huli Karthik, and many other artists have acted as characters.

Overall, this Devil movie is a feast for the audience, but there is some veju in it and some non-veju.

Pakka Paisa Vasool Movie Must Watch 🙏✨

I just watched the movie, and the way the scenes are framed keeps you guessing-you can't tell when the internal story ends and the movie concludes.

Darshan Sir's performance is outstanding! He portrays two distinct shades of his character, and for both, he delivers 100%. The director has crafted the film in a way that all Dboss fans will absolutely love.

Finally, "The Devil" is set to rule the cinema in the coming days!

If you haven't watched it yet, make sure to catch it at your nearest theater soon!

It is an empowering story about finding one's voice in a competitive world. With brilliant performances. The pacing is sharp, the dialogue witty, and the supporting cast adds humor and realism to the story. Each character adds something special to the story. Wonderful movie that people of all ages can enjoy.

DBoss has once again proved why he is the Sultan of the Screen! His performance in The Devil is nothing short of outstanding. From powerful dialogue delivery to electrifying screen presence, he carries the film with absolute dominance.

The entire team has done complete justice to the story and vision. Every department-direction, music, cinematography, and performances-has contributed brilliantly to make this film a memorable experience.

A must-watch for all DBoss fans and cinema lovers!

Jai DBoss! 🔥💥

Movie at first half is really great and the second half is okish as the dialogues are a bit repeated. And darshan sir's acting is really great ..that transition and all is just amazing. A new heroine is introduced to kannada film industry where she have done a great work. The movie is really good and watchable.
